gross_check.rule: |(f - o) - (E - F)| <= max(ms, rel * (E - F)), E = the last QUL word end; a verse failing it gets no word highlight

runtime.lame_bias_ms: -1105000/sampleRate when the file opens with a LAME/Info frame, else 0 (what a slice decode lacks against the whole file)
runtime.offset: word start = s - offset_ms[surah] - (window start in our file's time: originMs + cutStart + window start + lame bias)
runtime.onset: o = 10*k ms for the first 10 ms frame k of the verse window's envelope (SurahSlice.envelopeOf) with frames k..k+MAP_RUN-1 all above quietBelow(that envelope, MAP_REL); f = 10*(j+1) for the last frame j ending such a run
runtime.qul_times: word start = s - (window start in the file's time: originMs + cutStart + window start + lame bias)
runtime.shift: word start = o + (s - F) + bias_ms; F = the first QUL word start of the verse, s each word's
runtime.text: n = the largest QUL word position of the verse (largest end index for ayah spans); the app words if n equals their count, else the same with one JOINS pair counted as one word, whichever count is n; else no word highlight
